title: Backrooms: Liminal Spaces
description:
What happens when familiar places suddenly feel wrong?

Backrooms: Liminal Spaces is a personal Unreal Engine demo inspired by the unsettling atmosphere of liminal spaces and analog horror. Rather than focusing on jump scares, this project aims to create tension through environmental storytelling, realistic lighting, ambient sound, and an overwhelming sense of isolation.

The demo showcases my complete environment creation workflow—from blocking out the level and building a non-destructive modular environment to UV mapping, custom material creation in Substance Designer, and final assembly inside Unreal Engine 5. To complete the experience, I also developed a custom VHS post-processing effect that recreates the nostalgic found-footage aesthetic.

Every hallway, flickering fluorescent light, and empty room has been carefully designed to evoke the strange feeling of being somewhere both familiar and completely unknown. The goal was to capture the essence of liminal horror while exploring modern real-time rendering techniques and efficient environment production workflows.

If you're interested in Unreal Engine, environment art, technical art, or atmospheric horror, I hope you enjoy this small glimpse into the project. More environments, gameplay systems, and visual improvements are planned as development continues.

Thanks for watching, and don't forget to share your thoughts in the comments!

Made entirely in Unreal Engine 5 with custom materials, shaders, and a handcrafted VHS post-processing effect.

title: Tools & VFX Showreel
description:
Tools & VFX Showreel

This showreel is a collection of the technical tools, shaders, and real-time visual effects I've developed throughout my journey as a Technical Artist. It highlights my passion for combining programming with artistic workflows to build solutions that are both visually appealing and production-friendly.

The showcase includes custom editor tools, procedural workflows, gameplay VFX, stylized shaders, GPU-driven effects, and technical systems created using Unreal Engine. Every project was designed with a strong focus on performance, flexibility, and improving the overall content creation pipeline.

As a Technical Artist, I enjoy bridging the gap between artists and programmers by developing tools that speed up production while maintaining high visual quality. Whether it's creating reusable workflows, optimizing rendering techniques, or crafting impactful visual effects, my goal is always to make development more efficient without compromising creativity.

This reel represents a selection of my work and reflects my continued passion for real-time graphics, procedural content creation, and game development. I look forward to expanding this collection with more advanced tools, innovative VFX, and experimental rendering techniques in future projects.

Thank you for watching, and I hope you enjoy the showcase!
